question: Find the value of x in given equation: frac{sqrt{3+x}+sqrt{3-x}}{sqrt{3+x}-sqrt{3-x}} = 2
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply Componendo and Dividendo rule directly:

⇒ [√(3+x)] / [√(3−x)] = (2+1) / (2−1)

⇒ [√(3+x)] / [√(3−x)] = 3

Squaring both sides:

⇒ (3+x) / (3−x) = 9 ⇒ 3 + x = 27 − 9x ⇒ 10x = 24 ⇒ x = 12/5

**∴ The correct answer is 12/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

[√(3+x) + √(3−x)] / [√(3+x) − √(3−x)] = 2

**Method Used: Cross-multiplication**

⇒ √(3+x) + √(3−x) = 2 × [√(3+x) − √(3−x)]

⇒ √(3+x) + √(3−x) = 2√(3+x) − 2√(3−x)

⇒ √(3−x) + 2√(3−x) = 2√(3+x) − √(3+x)

⇒ 3√(3−x) = √(3+x)

Squaring both sides:

⇒ [3√(3−x)]² = [√(3+x)]²

⇒ 9 × (3 − x) = 3 + x

⇒ 27 − 9x = 3 + x

⇒ 27 − 3 = x + 9x

⇒ 24 = 10x

⇒ x = 24 / 10 = 12/5

**∴ The correct answer is 12/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Componendo and Dividendo

If a/b = c/d, then by this rule, (a+b) / (a−b) = (c+d) / (c−d). It quickly reduces complex fractions involving sums and differences of the same terms.

Squaring Equations

When dealing with expressions inside a square root (√), squaring both sides is the primary method to eliminate the root. Always verify roots back into the original equation to identify any extraneous solutions.

Cross Multiplication

For an equation of the form A/B = C/D, cross multiplying yields A × D = B × C, converting fractions into a simple linear expression.
